book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: U Uꞌ TZꞌIBꞌAL BꞌENXEꞌ QꞌU HEBREO Hebreos U uꞌuj uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan te unqꞌa tiaal Israel uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Nim talcheꞌ u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u Jesús
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, qitzꞌataj u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uveꞌ abꞌimal veꞌt sqaꞌn, tan asoj yeꞌ la kunima, as la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlen veꞌt u kutxumbꞌaleꞌ la kubꞌaneꞌ.
As u tzaqꞌiteꞌ uvaꞌ kat tal kan unqꞌa ángel, as techal chiteꞌ la nimali. As abꞌil uvaꞌ kat ipaasa tzii as yeꞌ kat inima, as tetzik chit veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ kat ul u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ stiꞌ.

¿As aꞌ kol chit yeꞌ la ibꞌan qꞌa sqe, asoj yeꞌ la qoksa qaama tiꞌ u sotzbꞌal paaveꞌ uveꞌ nim talcheꞌ? As tul aꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesús kat alon isuuchil u yoleꞌ sqe bꞌaxa. As kat yakꞌinsal veꞌt u yoleꞌ taꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, uvaꞌ kat abꞌin viyol Aakeꞌ.

As ech iyakꞌinsat Aakeꞌ viyoleꞌ. Kat ikꞌuch Aak unqꞌa kꞌuchbꞌal tetz viyakꞌileꞌ tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa uveꞌ kat ibꞌan Aak uvaꞌ kat teqꞌo taama unqꞌa tenameꞌ staꞌn. As kat ijatxbꞌen Aak u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ junun unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kat niman viyol Aakeꞌ, as kam uvaꞌ kat tal taama Aak tiꞌ taqꞌat ste.
Ni taqꞌ u Jesús tijleꞌm unqꞌa niman tetz
As jit tiqꞌabꞌ unqꞌa ángel la oksalkat u akꞌ txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uveꞌ la uli, tiꞌ tilpu isuuchil echeꞌ u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni qaleꞌ.
As ech ni tal umaꞌl u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan umaꞌl u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ:

content.text: ¿Kam chit tijleꞌm unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ qꞌi tiꞌ uvaꞌ nooksa eebꞌ tilil stiꞌ?
¿As kam chit tijleꞌm unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ qꞌi tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ul alocheꞌ?
Tan axheꞌ kat bꞌanon uvaꞌ bꞌiit kuxh yeꞌ kat lejon tijleꞌm unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa ángel.
As kat ooksa iqꞌii unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ echeꞌ umaj ijlenaal uvaꞌ la jeꞌ koroona tiꞌ iviꞌ;
As kat akꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt kan tiꞌ unqꞌa acheesaꞌmeꞌ uveꞌ kat abꞌana.
As kat aaqꞌ unqꞌa acheesaꞌmeꞌ skajayil te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ tilat isuuchil, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As u yoleꞌ u vaaꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ ni taleꞌ uvaꞌ kat taqꞌ u Tiixheꞌ unqꞌa icheesaꞌmeꞌ skajayil te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ tilat isuuchil. As aꞌ ni taleꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal Aak uvaꞌ jankꞌal unqꞌa icheesaꞌm Aakeꞌ, as la til unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ isuuchil. As jitꞌeꞌch nibꞌaneꞌ, tan yeꞌl unqꞌa icheesaꞌm Aakeꞌ skajayil ni til unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ isuuchil tijikil.

Pet ootzimal u Jesús sqaꞌn u ilol tetz isuuchil unqꞌa icheesaꞌm u Tiixheꞌ, uvaꞌ bꞌiil kuxh at kan u tijleꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa ángel tul kat ul vatz txꞌavaꞌ. As tul kat qꞌaav veꞌt Aak tu almikaꞌ, as nim talchu veꞌt Aak kat ibꞌana. As ibꞌaꞌnil kuxh u Tiixheꞌ kat ipalebꞌe u Jesús u kamchileꞌ sqiꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ kat oksal veꞌt iqꞌii u Jesús. As nim talchu veꞌt Aak cheel.

As u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ cheesan tetz unqꞌa cheesaꞌmeꞌ skajayil, as Aak ibꞌaal skajayil. As aꞌ nisaꞌ Aak uvaꞌ nimal unqꞌa tenameꞌ la ok smeꞌal ikꞌaol Aak, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la ilpi uvaꞌ nim talchu veꞌt Aak. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn veꞌt te Aak uvaꞌ techal kat ipalebꞌe u Jesús unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ aꞌ u Jesús la sotzsan kupaav.

As jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ txaael veꞌt oꞌ tiꞌ qok sitenam u Tiixheꞌ, as umaꞌl kuxh veꞌt Kubꞌaal tukꞌ u Jesús uvaꞌ ni oksan oꞌ sitenam u Tiixheꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ yeꞌl u Jesús nichꞌixveꞌ tiꞌ talataꞌ uvaꞌ qitzꞌin qatzik veꞌt qibꞌ tukꞌ Aak,
echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal umaꞌt u yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: La val isuuchil u yoleꞌ seeꞌ te unqꞌa vitzꞌin vatzikeꞌ.
As la unbꞌitza veꞌt axh xoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ nimol tibꞌ tiꞌ vabꞌiieꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As ech ni tal umaꞌt u yol ileꞌ:

content.text: La unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt unkꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As ni tal unpajte:

content.text: As il in at in tukꞌ unqꞌa meꞌal ikꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ kat alpu sve uvaꞌ la vil isuuchil, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ echat kat ibꞌan u Jesús echeꞌ oꞌ, tan at kuchiꞌol tukꞌ kukajal as tukꞌ kubꞌajil. As ech Aakeꞌ echeꞌ oꞌ kat ibꞌana tul kat ipalebꞌe Aak u kamchileꞌ tiꞌ itxꞌakon tiꞌ u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ uvaꞌ kat toksa tibꞌ sibꞌaalil unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni niman u Tiixheꞌ.
As kat ul u Jesús kamoj tiꞌ iqꞌalpul unqꞌa tenameꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ txeyik taꞌn u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ, tan nik ixoꞌv unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ ikameꞌ.
As ootzimal sqaꞌn uvaꞌ jit unqꞌa ángel kat ul iloch u Jesús. Pet oꞌ kat ul iloch oꞌ Aak, oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ tiaal u Abraham.

Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ techal chit kat ibꞌensa tibꞌ u Jesús echeꞌ oꞌ, tiꞌ uvaꞌ Aak veꞌt u Nimla oksan tetz kuyol vatz u Tiixheꞌ. As jik chit toksat Aak kuyol, tan nitxum Aak kuvatz. As estiꞌeꞌ kat ichoo Aak u kupaaveꞌ.
As kat ipalebꞌe Aak kꞌaxkꞌo tul kat chukax txumbꞌal tiꞌ Aak uvaꞌ la paavin Aak. As estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ootzimal veꞌt taꞌn Aak kam la tulbꞌe Aak kulochpeꞌ, tul nichukax txumbꞌal sqiꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la paavin oꞌ.
